callouts.explanation: QRadar computes this single score from severity, relevance, and credibility rather than exposing one fixed severity value - the field this section's prose is explaining.
An Offense bundles every contributing event matched against the same Rule for the same indexed entity over time, so this count reflects accumulated matches, not a single event.
Names the standing CRE Rule that chained the BB:LSASS-Access-Candidate Building Block match with the RS-Allowlisted-LSASS-Tools Reference Set check to produce this Offense.
Shows the entity (host asset) the Offense is indexed on, per DET-27-01's design choice in section 3.3 to index on source host rather than username alone.
